fixes.item: B-2 - a running analysis run is reported as a failed one (+ T11, same file, same round)
fixes.what_changed: localState() gained a 'running' branch that copies serverRunState's precedent exactly - text 'מסווג…', sub = the ALREADY_RUNNING constant (the server's own 409 wording, already in the file), action null, disabledAction RUN_LABEL - so the bar shows the running sentence and the run button is rendered DISABLED. fixes.item: T10 - missingReportParamsMessage had zero production importers while the screen printed the bare param name
fixes.what_changed: MissingParamsBanner now renders missingReportParamsMessage({}, names) instead of 'חסר פרמטר מערכת: ' + names.join(' · '): the RPC already decided who is missing (meta.missing_params), so an empty map plus the explicit name list yields exactly the locked sentence for those names - label, per-param effect, and the action. Second, necessary change in reportsParams.js: the effects clause is now emitted only when at least one effect is known. The live RPCs name params outside MISSING_EFFECTS (יחס_אורחים_לדיילת, תנאי_תשלום_ימים, קבוע_ריסון_m), and without that branch the banner would have read '...: X — . יש להוסיף...' - a dangling dash. No existing behaviour changed (all four names in the map have effects), and reportsParams.test.js stayed green.

blind_spot: MISSING_EFFECTS in src/lib/reportsParams.js has rows for FOUR param names, but NINE distinct names can reach meta.missing_params from the m11 RPCs - measured this turn by pulling every quoted Hebrew literal next to v_missing across supabase/migrations/*module11*.sql plus the v_param_name constants. Covered: מכפיל_מרווח_מתרחק, סף_סטיית_תקציב_אחוז, מקדם_אמינות_אדום, מקדם_אמינות_ענבר. NOT covered: מינימום_תשובות_להצגת_ציון, סף_לקוח_רדום_ימים, קבוע_ריסון_m, תנאי_תשלום_ימים, יחס_אורחים_לדיילת. For those five the banner now says the label, the name and the action but NOT the per-param consequence - which is the exact property reportsParams.js's own header claims for itself ('השלכה פר-פרמטר ולא משפט כללי'). Checkable true-or-false by comparing Object.keys(MISSING_EFFECTS) with that grep. It is strictly better than the bare name that shipped, and the sentence is well formed (I added the branch that drops the dangling dash), but T10 is only fully closed once five effect sentences are worded - and the wording is Ishay's, not mine.
